lines.en: Listen, I want to talk to you about that girl that you're dancing with.
She's nice, huh? I think I almost brought my wife to this.
Yeah. Yeah. Okay.
Look, buddy, I came with that girl, okay?
And I had this plan to kiss her at the New Year's countdown.
I'm trying to win her over, you know?
So I was wondering if...
I don't think so.
Oh, come on, man. You can dance with my partner.
She's real mellow.
Look, you, uh, are you dating this girl you came with?
Well, I was hoping after tonight that maybe I could, you know...
No, no. She's fair game if you ask me. Sorry, buddy.
All right.
Hey, you know, fair is fair.
I mean, you know, when you're right, you're right.
What can I say? But...
Hey, oh, no!
No!
What, are you in the second grade?
Hey, man, you're the one who wet his pants.
Hey! Hey! Hey!
Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey.
